title: That I May Dwell among Them
text: And they are to make a sanctuary for Me, so that I may dwell among them.

title: According to the Pattern
text: You must make the tabernacle and design all its furnishings according to the pattern I show you.

title: Whose Heart Stirred Him
text: And everyone whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD …

title: Gold Jewelry
text: So all who had willing hearts, both men and women, came and brought brooches and earrings, rings and necklaces, and all kinds of gold jewelry.

title: Blue, Purple and Scarlet Yarn
text: Everyone who had blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen, goat hair, ram skins dyed red, or articles of fine leather, brought them.

title: Acacia Wood
text: Also, everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the service brought it.

title: Olive Oil for the Light
text: … as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

title: A Freewill Offering
text: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD …

title: Bezalel
text: See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

title: Filled with the Spirit of God
text: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship …

title: A Master of Every Craft
text: … to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.

title: More than Enough
text: The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do.

title: No More!
text: No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary.

title: The Work Was Completed
text: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed.

title: Just as the LORD Commanded
text: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

title: The Ark
text: And they are to construct an ark of acacia wood …

title: The Mercy Seat
text: And I will meet with you there above the mercy seat …

title: The First Day of the First Month
text: On the first day of the first month you are to set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting.

title: Moses Did Everything
text: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him.

title: The Cloud Covered the Tent
text: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting …

title: The Glory of the LORD
text: … and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

title: Moses Was Unable to Enter
text: Moses was unable to enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled on it …

title: When the Cloud Lifted
text: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out through all the stages of their journey.

title: Fire by Night
text: For the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night …

title: He Made His Dwelling among Us
text: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us.

title: Oholiab
text: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

title: Skilled Women Spun
text: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun …

title: Willing Hearts
text: So all who had willing hearts, both men and women, came and brought …

title: The Holy Garments
text: … for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its services, and for the holy garments.

title: More Than Enough
text: … what they already had was more than enough to perform all the work.
